title: Release retry does not actually retry after timeout
body: Retry path clones the release target and calls Execute again, but the timeout from attempt 1 is carried into the clone so attempt 2 aborts instantly. Auto-closed by the stale bot with no fix. Reported twice since.

title: Ban expiry renders unparsed timestamp
body: When expiresAt is not RFC3339 the raw string leaks into the ban dialog. Auto-closed as stale.
